Spiko identifies the exact USTBL Ethereum NAV proxy 0x477e363c51Ab0C4D13B22CD6B57D56d4a3Cb7Abe; Chainlink's NAVLink directory identifies CACEIS as the fund-administrator source and a 97200-second heartbeat. At finalized Ethereum block 26271962 (2026-10-25T20:04:11.000Z; hash 0x49f502645f75fab5c476eca58a1665fb324be72e5132c713680fe7821c8e6b2c), description() returned USTBL NAV, decimals() returned 6 and aggregator() returned 0xc1c24f0f2103f5899b7ab415a1930e519b7d3423. This establishes external publication of administrator NAV, not independent asset valuation, a second pricing authority, automatic failover or publisher signer closure.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USTBL's September 2026 prospectus lists eight token deployments, including Solana in addition to the seven recorded EVM, Stellar and Starknet routes. The Solana mint, issuer minter-program configuration PDA and admin-vault identities are identified; protective governance, mutable limits, program-upgrade authority and production bridge-route controls remain unresolved. Spiko announced Chainlink CCIP for compliance-aware cross-chain movement; no production CCIP adapter or token pool, lane, peer, rate limit, or bridge controller was identified in the reviewed primary sources. The provisional external-validated-network tier is unchanged, and issuer mint controls remain in Mint Authority rather than being treated as bridge controls.
